name: mirage
text: Measured it on the last warm engine job (47,316 requests): the fair-odds coverage is NOT what's blocking it any more (only 2.6% skipped for 'no fair line'; 4% of legs unpriced). What blocks quotes now: 32% parlays with two legs in one game that we don't model (not side+total), 28% two player props in one game (modelled by the other session but still paper-only), 22% games starting within 20 minutes, then your own live options (longshots only, today's slate only) about 6%. The 75% 'no fair line' you see on the Parlays screen is a freshly restarted engine job: it takes 10-15 minutes to refill and we restarted it about every hour today. What I changed just now: games starting within 10 minutes can be quoted (was 20). Next: make restarts warm up faster, and the same-game prop pairs need to go from paper to live (the other session's model).
